title: Register as patient
story: As a visitor, I want to register using my name, email, mobile number and password so that I can access patient services.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid unique details create account and JWT
missing fields or short password are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Sign in securely
story: As a visitor, I want to sign in with my registered email and password so that I can access my account.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid credentials return an authenticated session
invalid credentials return no token.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: View my account
story: As a authenticated user, I want to view my authenticated profile so that I can confirm my identity and role.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid JWT returns the current user
missing or invalid JWT is rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Log out
story: As a authenticated user, I want to log out of the website so that my browser no longer uses my session.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout clears the client-side session
protected screens require a new login.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Browse approved doctors
story: As a visitor, I want to see a list of approved doctors so that I can choose a healthcare specialist.
acceptanceCriteria: Only approved doctors appear
an empty list is handled clearly.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: View doctor details
story: As a visitor, I want to view an approved doctor's information so that I can decide whether to book.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid approved doctor details are returned
invalid or unapproved IDs are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Check public available slots
story: As a visitor, I want to check a doctor's remaining future appointment slots before logging in so that I can plan a visit.
acceptanceCriteria: Public result shows open slots only
private booking details are not exposed.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Apply to become a doctor
story: As a patient, I want to submit a professional doctor application so that an administrator can review my request.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid application is stored as pending
validation errors are reported.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Prevent duplicate pending application
story: As a patient, I want the system to prevent duplicate pending doctor applications so that the review queue stays consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: A second application while the first is pending is rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: List pending doctor applications
story: As a administrator, I want to see pending doctor applications so that I can review requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Admins see pending submissions
patients are forbidden.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Approve a doctor
story: As a administrator, I want to approve an eligible pending doctor application so that the doctor can access doctor features.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending record becomes approved and user gets doctor role
non-admin cannot approve.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Reject a doctor application
story: As a administrator, I want to reject a pending doctor application so that invalid requests do not receive doctor access.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending application becomes rejected
non-admin requests are forbidden.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Edit professional profile
story: As a doctor, I want to update my doctor profile so that patients can view accurate professional details.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized doctor changes valid fields
invalid changes are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Configure weekly working schedule
story: As a doctor, I want to configure my weekly sessions and slot duration so that patients book only during working hours.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid sessions and supported slot durations save
overlapping sessions and unsupported durations are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Block unavailable dates
story: As a doctor, I want to block days when I am unavailable so that no bookable slots appear on those dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid blocked dates save
slot availability excludes blocked days.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Find authenticated appointment slots
story: As a patient, I want to view future free slots for an approved doctor so that I can select a valid time.
acceptanceCriteria: Available slots respect schedule, existing bookings and date
past dates are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Book an available appointment
story: As a patient, I want to reserve an open slot with a doctor so that I can receive a pending appointment.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid booking creates Pending appointment
unavailable times are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Prevent double booking
story: As a patient, I want the same doctor slot to be reserved at most once so that two patients cannot hold the identical active slot.
acceptanceCriteria: Competing requests produce at most one active booking
conflicting attempt is rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: View my appointments
story: As a patient, I want to view my own booked appointments and their statuses so that I can track visits.
acceptanceCriteria: Only my appointments are visible after authentication.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: View assigned appointments
story: As a doctor, I want to view only appointments assigned to me so that I can manage my patient schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: Assigned doctor sees own appointments
other doctors' bookings stay private.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Approve or reject pending appointment
story: As a doctor, I want to approve or reject a pending booking so that the patient knows whether it is accepted.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending can transition to Approved or Rejected
other doctors cannot change it.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Complete an approved appointment
story: As a doctor, I want to mark an approved appointment completed so that the visit workflow is finalized.
acceptanceCriteria: Only Approved becomes Completed
terminal states cannot be reopened.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Attach a supported medical document
story: As a patient, I want to attach an optional medical document while booking so that my doctor has relevant context.
acceptanceCriteria: PDF, JPEG or PNG files up to 5 MiB are accepted
disallowed formats and excess size are rejected.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Access assigned patient's medical document
story: As a doctor, I want to securely retrieve an attachment for my assigned appointment so that I can review it.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the assigned doctor may access an attached file
other users cannot.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution

title: Read and manage notifications
story: As a authenticated user, I want to view my notifications and mark them as read so that I can keep track of appointment updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Only own notifications are returned
update routes affect only owned records.
status: Documented — acceptance criteria require verification before AI test execution
